inputs.title: Gáspár et al. (2023), Nature Astronomy 7, 790: reduced F2550W image F2550W_finalsc_DC.fits
inputs.credit: NASA/ESA/CSA JWST, MIRI GTO programme 1193 (PI G. Rieke); Gáspár et al. 2023, Nature Astronomy 7, 790 (arXiv:2305.03789), reduced images from github.com/merope82/Fomalhaut
inputs.displayCredit: NASA/ESA/CSA JWST; Gáspár et al. (2023), Nature Astronomy 7, 790
inputs.acquisition: Downloaded unchanged from the authors' repository github.com/merope82/Fomalhaut at commit 3566f5976f8a029703b05550004c347d58aa0a85 (tools/objects/circumstellar/fit-figure-stretch.mts depositFile), checked against its pinned bytes and sha256. The star's position is not in its header: TARG_RA and TARG_DEC of MAST’s level-3 product of the same F2550W visit, jw01193-o013_t015_miri_f2550w-brightsky_i2d.fits (2022-10-22), the target position with its proper motion to that date.
inputs.license: The authors publish their reduced images for download with the paper (its Data Availability statement) and state no licence; they derive from JWST data that carry no copyright. The files are fetched at preparation time, pinned by sha256, and not redistributed; the rendered volume credits the authors and the mission.
